groups.title: Formula is not evaluated before export assertion
groups.owner: XLSX integration and formula engine owners
groups.assessment: diagnosed as integration fixture setup gap from test code and failure location
groups.diagnosis: All three value assertions fail before export/re-import matters: the standalone test setup creates Workbook/Worksheet without attaching FormulaEngine, so formula values remain null. Minimal reproduction: instantiate Workbook, add a sheet, set A1 and A2, set A3 formula =A1+A2, read A3; compare without and with the FormulaEngine setup used by core tests.

groups.title: XLSX importer does not decode inline strings
groups.assessment: confirmed production fidelity gap by export/import source inspection
groups.diagnosis: Exporter writes inline strings under <is><t>, while importer obtains text from <v>; imported content is empty. Minimal reproduction: set A1 to Text, export, reload, read A1; it is empty.

groups.title: XLSX export/import drops formula expressions
groups.assessment: confirmed production fidelity gap by source inspection
groups.diagnosis: Exporter serializes cell values but does not emit formula elements; importer does not restore them. Minimal reproduction: set A1 formula =10+20, export, reload, inspect getCell(A1).formula; it is undefined.
